messages:
priya_cs: Quick sync — Pelorus private/VPC deploy reported two immediate blockers from their security team :warning:
priya_cs: 1) Audit logs retention currently 30 days in our config; customer requires 365d for compliance.
priya_cs: 2) KMS rotation window: their policy mandates 90d rotation, our default CMK rotation is 1y. They also asked about ability to bring their own key (BYOK).
priya_cs: Also FYI they saw a tokenized usage spike during a load test — finance raised a renewal risk flag if month-end billing looks unexpected.

tom_net: ack, looking. Do we have current CloudTrail/Splunk forwarding config for their VPC?
tom_net: need to confirm retention is controllable on our side or if they must configure collector AWS side.

maya_infra: I can pull the deployment config. Initial glance: log-forwarder uses our central log-bucket with lifecycle 30d. We can change bucket lifecycle to 365d but need product signoff for storage cost chargeback.

oliver_csm: @priya_cs please loop in procurement/finance for cost note. Customer willing to accept incremental cost but wants explicit estimate before committing.

priya_cs: noted. @maya_infra can you attach expected incremental S3 storage estimate (30d->365d) and any ingest egress delta?

maya_infra: will do. quick config snippet we run on the forwarder:```json
{"destination_bucket": "redwood-pelorus-logs", "lifecycle_days": 30, "enabled": true}
```
maya_infra: We can update to "lifecycle_days": 365 but need to update our infra-as-code repo and schedule a short deploy.

oliver_csm: On the KMS side: Pelorus security insists on a managed rotation cadence of 90d and tenant controlled key material. Are we supporting BYOK for Private customers?

maya_infra: We support customer-managed CMKs in Private mode (they can supply ARN). BYOK/HSM varies by on-prem vs VPC. For VPC quick option: they can give us a key ARN in their account and we use cross-account grants. For on-prem we have extra steps.

priya_cs: Pelorus asked for a proof-of-concept: short run where they rotate key after 30 days and validate decrypts still succeed. Can we schedule a canary rotation playbook?

maya_infra: yes — I can run a canary with a staging CMK. Steps: grant, rotate, verify KMS decrypt on sample artifact. Added note: rotation frequency below 7 days will break cached token signing; 30d should be fine.

onboard-bot: runbook created by maya_infra — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pelorus-kms-audit-2026 (access: pelorus-team, cs-team)

priya_cs: great. For the billing spike: can eng attach a short explanation of what causes short-lived peaks (retries, warmup, KV cache misses)? Pelorus is worried about surprise renewal charges.

maya_infra: short answer: early load tests can spike tokenized cost due to cold caches and elevated batch sizes. Suggest we set a controlled test window and cap rate limiting on their tenant for the next billing cycle.

oliver_csm: I'll propose a mitigation: switch temporary quota cap + scheduled warmup period. Also add a line item in renewal discussion: 30-day trial usage excluded from committed baseline.

priya_cs: Action items:
- maya_infra: PR to infra repo to change lifecycle_days -> 365 + storage delta estimate (due EOD 1799999050)
- maya_infra: create KMS canary rotation playbook and run on staging (due 1799999080)
- tom_net: confirm cross-account grant steps and firewall egress for key use (due 1799999060)
- oliver_csm: draft renewal mitigation language and cost note for customer (due 1799999100)

priya_cs: tagging here so we can resolve before Friday cutover. If any dependency needs product approval, flag immediately.

tom_net: noted, will post firewall rule snippet if any extra ports are required.

maya_infra: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/pelorus/pulls/42 — includes lifecycle change and tests.

priya_cs: thanks team. pelorus contact (Anya) asked for daily brief until EOD Friday — I'll run the standup.

oliver_csm: i'll join daily; will prep finance slide for customer's SOW addendum.

onboard-bot: reminder scheduled: Daily Pelorus standup @ 09:30 PST starting 1799999065

priya_cs: closing loop here — marking thread as in-flight. Will update last_message_ts when the canary completes.
